Reviewer: wopr pool job review-4232, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney (/home/mikekinney/.claude-mkinney); did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers. The author is not a collaborator, so the maintainer approves and merges by hand.

Ownership record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4232#issuecomment-7224576021

## Scope

- Head `cf3565107`, trial-merged locally with `upstream/main` `751a79b20`. The merge is clean.
- The diff has four commits. Three are the parent PRs #4218, #4220 and #4221 (the form-seam migration). One is this PR's own commit (#1119 slice 3). This review read the whole diff, so it covers the parent commits too.
- The diff is in `crates/ui` and `docs/decisions/` only. It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. This is not a safety-tier review.
- No process file, `build.rs`, `scripts/`, `.github/` or dependency change.

## What looks good

- `layout/row_name.rs`: `named_by` saves the outer open row and restores it after the closure. Thus a nested row and a field after a row get the correct name, or no name. The old `row_label_id` gave the last row of the frame, which can be the wrong row.
- `prop_row` opens the row. `num`, `plain_drag`, `value_with_unit`, `combo`, `combo_owned`, `tool_combo`, `drag_row` and the spindle field take the row name through `name_by_row`.
- The `*_row` variants are now aliases of their bases. I checked each caller of `num_row`, `num_feed_row`, `num_plain_row`, `num_unit_row` and `int_range_row` in the merged tree. Each caller is inside a `prop_row` or `prop_row_hint`. Thus no field loses the name that it had before.
- The header combos (Tool, Source, Setup, Coolant) are named by their `Grid` labels through `named_by`.
- The page migrations keep the same behaviour: `button_enabled`, `small_button_enabled`, `checkbox`, `note`, `list_row_truncated` and `radio_pair` (same draw order) are thin wrappers of the raw calls. `the_2d_seam_helpers_keep_clicks_text_and_names` pins the disabled-click and toggle behaviour.
- The guard `every_operation_page_tab_names_every_input` walks each registry kind and each tab. It also fails on one label that names one input two times.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` outside tests. Provenance lines are on the new modules. Decision records are present. The new test is a module of the lib tests, not a new binary.
- Before and after screenshots are in the body (images-only `pr-screenshots` branch of the fork).

## Results (locally, on the trial merge)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 10 steps, 0 failed. `ui suites: lib`: 1770 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored.
- All `crates/ui` suites, because `prop_row` reaches each page: `cargo xtask gate batch --only ui`: 27 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (lib, bins, boundary, boundary_picks, catalog_render, contour_dxf_sketch, diag_events, edge_loop_pick, egui_app, feedback, fixtures, gpu_render, machine, models, operations, play_layer_gpu, shell, sinker_setup, startup_log, tap_hand, theme_example, theme_files, theme_shell_metrics, trace_composite, trace_parity, waterjet_tool, doc). The host has a software GPU adapter (llvmpipe). No UI suite failed for an adapter reason.
- `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-ui -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Heavy lanes: the diff reaches none. Not run.

Extra suites run: none were owed. The diff does not change `testdata/`, a fixture or golden directory, or the import code.

Goldens moved: none. The diff changes no `*.nc`, `*.cl`, `tests/golden/` or `examples/catalog/` file, and no snapshot PNG.

## Mutations (each reverted after the run)

1. `name_by_row` returns the response without `labelled_by`: `every_operation_page_tab_names_every_input` is red with 1305 lines. Green again after the revert.
2. The Coolant header combo is drawn without `named_by`: the same test is red with 202 lines, `<kind> / <tab>: ComboBox on "Coolant": no name`. Green again after the revert.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `layout/form.rs` grows from 420 to 424 lines. It was over the 400-line limit before this PR. A later split along the row/field seam is a good follow-up.
- Two seam fields in one `prop_row` now get the same row name. A screen reader reads the same name for two controls. The guard does not find this case. It is outside the scope of this slice.
- Merge order: merge #4218, #4220 and #4221 first, then this PR. If this PR merges first, it also merges the three parent commits. This review covered them, so the result is the same code.

Requested before merge: none.
